commits.summary: After credential submit, tolerate a transient missing/throwing owned-tab document read by polling until the existing deadline; continue enforcing the current-run authority fence, HTTPS same-origin check, and fail-closed timeout behavior.

affected_features.impact: Existing case already exercises an admitted credential attempt with a lost post-submit document. Refine its procedure and expected result to cover transient null/throwing reads that recover to a valid same-origin document before deadline, plus persistent loss that times out without accepting an observation. The behavior is in local-browser credential execution, not a new Vault UI action.
Generic credential_login manual-execution case may exercise this path, but its existing source status is design-needed and it is not a substitute for the concrete deferred Pilot T03 case.

commits.inventory_case_action: Update EXT-F-2014-T03. No new control is warranted: the change adds recovery behavior inside the existing admitted credential operation and creates no user-facing control.
commits.runtime_status: Source-only. No test/build/browser execution was performed; this report does not establish runtime behavior.
